login.tagline: Weighted votes with unique links and surveys with delegation, in a single platform.

features.elections: Votes with one or more motions and bulk voter import from CSV.
features.surveys: Automatically categorized surveys with delegation and consolidated progress.
features.security: Google SSO sign-in and permissions enforced by the server.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Google account to enter the portal.
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
login.missingClientId: Google sign-in is not configured. Set VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in client/.env.
login.googleFailed: Google did not complete the sign-in. Please try again.
login.ssoNotice: Your identity is verified by the server with Google; your password is never stored.
login.votersNotice: Did you receive a voting link? Open it straight from your email: no sign-in is needed.

codes.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Check your connection or that the backend is running.
codes.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session is not valid or has expired. Please sign in again.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
codes.NOT_FOUND: The requested resource does not exist.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server had a problem. Please try later.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
codes.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check the data you entered.
codes.INVALID_JSON: The request format is not valid.

codes.VOTERS_ALREADY_EXIST: Some voters are already registered in this vote. Nothing was imported.

codes.SURVEY_NOT_FOUND: The survey does not exist or you have no access to it.
codes.QUESTION_ALREADY_ANSWERED: This question has already been answered.

codes.INVALID_EMAIL: The email address is not valid.
codes.LENGTH_REQUIRED: The upload size could not be determined.

details.CSV_UNTERMINATED_QUOTE: A quoted field is never closed.
details.CSV_TOO_MANY_ROWS: At most {value} voters are allowed per file.
details.CSV_TOO_MANY_FIELDS: the row has more fields than the header.
details.CSV_INVALID_BIRTHDATE: invalid birthdate (use YYYY-MM-DD or DD-MM-YYYY, in the past).
details.CSV_INVALID_WEIGHT: the weight must be a number greater than 0.
details.CSV_EXTENSION: The voter list must be a .csv file.
details.MOTIONS_INVALID_JSON: The motions are not in a valid format.
details.MOTION_OPTIONS_COUNT: it needs between 2 and 10 different options.
details.MOTION_OPTION_TOO_LONG: each option allows at most 60 characters.
details.ATTACHMENT_CONTENT_MISMATCH: {value}: the content does not match the extension.
details.INVALID_EMAIL: The email address is not valid.

voting.title: Ballot
voting.greeting: Hello, {name}. Review each motion and choose an option.
voting.instructions: This vote has {count} motion(s). Choose an option for each one and confirm at the end. You can vote only once.
voting.confirmText: Check your choices. Once sent, the vote cannot be changed.
voting.successText: Your vote on {count} motion(s) was recorded secretly. You can close this page now.

blocked.invalidText: We could not find a ballot for this link. Make sure you copied it completely from your email, or ask the organizer for a new one.

blocked.expiredText: This link is no longer valid. Ask the organizer for a new link.
blocked.closedText: This vote no longer accepts ballots.

errors.attachmentSize: Attachments cannot exceed 10 MB in total.
